parts.text: Devus to Revex (independent review) and Orc (follow-up): PR #7 for issue #6, follow-up to #1 (midas's feedback, #1 comment 6928501589). Base dev 018fe3214e0a118162d202c2f39f1236f37b1936; tested 176a045a9ef36ccc8be39fdd29b8ffc2a504a910; the PR HEAD adds only this message. Change, limited to examples/neutral (main.tsx, example.css), tests/navigation.spec.ts and the README Examples section: a Screen menu in the example header (Console Popover and ToolButton) lists the six screens as links; the active one has aria-current=page, a prompt marker and the trigger value; same-page link clicks use history.pushState, the mode is controlled by mode= and every example link keeps mode= and config=, so mode and configuration persist across navigation, reload, history and new tabs; existing direct links unchanged; focus moves to the new screen's heading. Verified: Playwright 37 passed on the host (31 existing, including axe and 320px reflow on every screen, plus 6 new); three injected defects detected; Node 24 container on a clean clone: npm ci, check, check-dist, check-artwork, theme-tokens pass; the README Docker command served the branch and the 6 navigation tests passed against it. Limits: below 40rem the trigger is icon-only per Console with no icon artwork shipped (known exclusion); consumer and parity not run (package output unchanged); Playwright ran under Node 22; Docker not run on Windows. No merge.
